It serves models over REST (FastAPI/uvicorn) and gRPC using the V2 Inference Protocol (KServe/Seldon). It supports multi-model serving, parallel inference workers, adaptive batching, Kafka, and Prometheus metrics. The package defines an 'mlserver' CLI entrypoint that starts the server, and the repo ships Dockerfiles (including Konflux builds) that produce a runnable server container image, used as a KServe serving runtime. It is also pip-installable and offers a runtime extension API (runtimes/ contains sklearn, xgboost, etc.), but its main role in RHOAI is a deployed long-running inference service, not a library or an operator. It has no CRDs or controllers.
